rationale: Baseline plus one added parameter at a time: nonnegative speed-dependent loss or bounded monotone arrow curvature. No combined candidate, per-label speeds, offsets or per-shot fitted clocks. q is arrow length/BW, not normalized game power; gain retains s^-1 at q=0.2. Bounds are offline search limits, not physical estimates.
objective: Equal-weight mean of per-shot mean squared 2D centre errors at original PTS, including repeated centres. No interpolation/deduplication or fitted direction. Existing annotated directions remain conditional initial observations.
cross_validation: Six leave-one-shot-out folds within training_ids; fit five, score omitted shot. No historical holdout or break access in numerical comparison. Internal folds are not fresh validation.

selection.policy: Prefer constant unless an extension improves aggregate CV RMSE by at least 10% and individual RMSE in at least 5/6 folds. Rank eligible extensions by CV RMSE then candidate order. This selects a follow-up hypothesis only, never a usable profile.

uncertainty.policy: Refit all six training shots coherently for each single perturbation, separately per candidate. No per-shot alignment. Samples before a shifted release predict stationary start. Ranges are sensitivities, not confidence intervals.

identifiability: Report fold and perturbation parameter ranges, normalized finite-difference residual Jacobian column norms/correlations and bound proximity; no confidence/probability claims. Local diagnostics retain negative estimates and coordinate sensitivity.
audit: Check training samples against full numeric extraction PTS/marker rows and hashes; report exact repeated-position run brackets and missing-marker times. Audit first isolated segment at 0.1/0.2/0.4s windows and final isolated segment using original samples, no inferred updates or annotation corrections from residuals.
historical_holdouts: Already viewed in CB-37; excluded entirely, no retrospective rescore in this report.
readiness: Inconclusive or diagnosed mismatch is acceptable. Unknown build/equipment/physical mm remain unknown. Fresh controlled phone acquisition required. No production change or live enablement.
